source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This port supplies the explicit native=false flag both in source markup and in actual runtime/template builders: the tree column picker, editable-menulist fallback and OpenPGP key More menu. Its unified-toolbar setup similarly configures main/submenu popups, while direct assertions check button pressed state rather than native mode. Accepted examples later lack these explicit flags, so reuse this as a historical construction-scope example, not a permanent requirement to set this attribute. Native rendering and keyboard behavior were not executed.
title: The native-menu sweep also changes runtime and template popup construction
